_comment: Contract artifact documenting the module's routes/nav for the module validator. The actual TypeScript/React source lives under web/shell/src/modules/docs/: the shell has no remote module loading, so its local module registry (web/shell/src/modules/registry.ts) is the only way a module ships frontend code. Same as notification's and timesheet's own frontend.manifest.json.
_featureKeyComment: Routes gate on 'docs.access' (the generic <moduleKey>.access key internal/authz/summary.go synthesizes for any enabled module at company scope) rather than authz.fragment.json's fine-grained 'docs.manage'/'docs.create', because the fragment-declared feature keys are not granted to users through the route resolver. Per-document viewer/editor access is enforced server-side by the authz object-mode check, not by this frontend gate.
